title: Identity comparison for common-stage derived pullback
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, a simultaneous coefficient comparison system $S$ [def-fd-pullback-comparison-datum], and its scheme coherence $h_S$ [lem-fd-rational-coefficient-category-comparison]. Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme of finite topological Krull dimension such that $\ell$ is a unit in every stalk. The recorded common-stage derived pullback along $\mathrm{id}_X$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], using the canonical residue-field inverses supplied by stalk invertibility, is naturally isomorphic to the identity functor of the algebraically closed constructible coefficient category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. No separatedness or nonemptiness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Remark 6.8.15, identity compatibility; Stacks Tag 099N, completed pullback identity comparison

proof.text: Take compatible rational identity isomorphisms at every finite coefficient stage. Identify the chosen common-stage pullback object with its prescribed pair by its uniqueness specification. The component at (E,K) is the stage inclusion applied to the rational identity comparison on K.

Every arrow is represented at a common finite stage L. The prescribed pullback map is beta_P followed by rational pullback of the representative followed by beta_Q inverse. Rewrite each component using the stage inclusion formula. Scalar compatibility cancels beta_Q inverse, rational naturality moves the identity unit past the representative, and compatibility at P gives the required equality. Thus these objectwise isomorphisms form a natural isomorphism; compose with the initial equality identification.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStageDerivedPullback_identity
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type v)
    [Field Ω] [Algebra ℚ_[l] Ω] [IsAlgClosure ℚ_[l] Ω]
    (S : FdCoefficientComparisonSystem.{u} l Ω)
    (hs : FdComparisonSchemeCoherence l Ω S)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    [Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X ≤ n)]
    [Fact (∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x))] :
    Nonempty (commonStageDerivedPullback l Ω (𝟙 X) ≅ 𝟭 _)
